claim: a per-print PREMIUM threshold identifies blocks better than a fixed lot-size threshold, because SPX per-contract prices span three orders of magnitude in one session

outcome: TRUE, measured on 26,837 real SPX prints 2026-08-07 ($108.9M). corr(size,premium)=+0.29. At matched selectivity lot>=10 captures 42.6% of premium vs 59.5% by premium (+17.0pt); overlap only 32.3%. His-only prints median $1.65/contract at 1.19% OTM, mine-only $34.77 at 0.42% — the mechanism claim (cheap wings over the money) is exactly confirmed. Holds at every threshold 2..100 (+10 to +17pt). Caveat: lot count still carries a behavioural signature premium misses (many small wings = tail hedging), so both are stored and neither is called institutional. One session, one expiry.
